captures.caption: MCP servers
captures.alt: MCP servers with masked credentials, a connection test and cached tool descriptions.

captures.caption: MCP tool calls
captures.alt: The MCP tool call log with key, User, server, tool, status, latency and error class. Arguments and results are not stored.

captures.caption: Overview
captures.alt: The Overview page in Full Mode. It shows the Proxy base URL, the totals for 24 hours, three charts and the By Model table.

captures.caption: Overview (light theme)
captures.alt: The Overview page in the light theme.

captures.caption: Routes
captures.alt: The Routes page. The Route "smart" uses the weighted strategy with three Deployments on two Providers and two Fallbacks.

captures.caption: Routes (light theme)
captures.alt: The Routes page in the light theme.

captures.caption: Ledger
captures.alt: The newest Ledger Entries with the filters. Each row shows the User, the Model and Provider, the status, the flags, the tokens, the amounts and the latency.

captures.caption: Add a Provider
captures.alt: The searchable Provider picker. The search "kimi" finds verified presets, the Kimi Code sign-in and entries from models.dev.

captures.caption: Add a Provider form
captures.alt: The guided form for DeepSeek. It shows only the fields that this Provider needs and a summary of the result.

captures.caption: Providers
captures.alt: Two API-key Providers and four Subscription Providers. The page shows only the last 4 characters of each key, or the name of its environment variable.

captures.caption: Sign-in
captures.alt: The sign-in panel of a Codex Provider. Paste the redirect URL here when device sign-in is not available.

captures.caption: Models
captures.alt: The Models with their Cost Card rates, Price Cards, Team overrides and the Default Markup.

captures.caption: Model page
captures.alt: The cards of one Model, a Team override and the Card history.

captures.caption: Users
captures.alt: The name search, the Users with their Teams, Budgets, Rate Limits and spend, and the pager.

captures.caption: Keys
captures.alt: The form to add a Virtual Key with Provider Access and Rate Limits, the active keys and the pager.

captures.caption: Usage
captures.alt: The "Show all" view of the Overview: usage by User, sorted by requests, one page at a time.

captures.caption: Overview in Simple Mode
captures.alt: The Overview without money data: requests, tokens, latency, errors and attempts.

captures.caption: Teams
captures.alt: Teams with their Budgets, spend and member counts.

captures.caption: Settings
captures.alt: The operating mode, routing settings, metrics and alert controls.

captures.caption: Secret stores
captures.alt: Owner-only Secret stores settings with encrypted auth settings, a private-address control and a refresh interval.

captures.caption: Audit log
captures.alt: The audit log: who changed what and when, with filters and the pager.

captures.caption: Guardrails
captures.alt: A rule set in the rule editor with a detector, a regex and a keyword rule, its Route attachment and a test box for pasted text.
